newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE March white sugar re-conquers $300 at close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE March white sugar re-conquers $300 at close.

text.p: Benchmark London white sugar futures managed to grab $300 again in last-minute dealings on Monday after slipping under it on commission house sales.
March sugar recovered from a low of $299.40 a tonne, which almost dashed hopes for a follow-up rally after a surge on Friday above the key psychological mark of $300.
The close of $300 on March represented a loss of 30 cents on the day after an intraday rise to $301.40 helped by an initial spate of short covering.
May also erased some of its losses, finishing 10 cents lower at $298.50. The March/May premium was down to $1.50 from $2.00 earlier in the session.
